description: Use when an agent needs a short claim checked against sources. Returns SUPPORTED, CONTRADICTED or INSUFFICIENT, with every supporting line quoted word for word from a filing, Wikipedia article or URL. No readable source answers 404 or 503, not charged. Costs 0.15 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

claim.description: the claim to check: one statement of fact, 10 to 300 characters

urls.description: up to 3 https URLs of pages that should settle it, comma separated or repeat the parameter; omit them and the service reads one SEC filing when the claim carries an explicit ticker such as $AAPL, else the Wikipedia articles the claim names

name: get_claim_check

data.description: the get_claim_check payload; a real captured example is free at https://x402.ochinimus.app/api/sample/get_claim_check

tool.description: the tool that produced this payload

title: Claim check
